fields.name: Athlete
fields.description: +1 to physical actions involving sustained movement, climbing, or jumping.

fields.name: Keen Eye
fields.description: +1 when searching for small details, tracks, traps, or hidden objects.

fields.name: Silver Tongue
fields.description: +1 to persuasion when the character has time to explain their position.

fields.name: Survivor
fields.description: +1 to endure harsh weather, hunger, exhaustion, or difficult travel.

fields.name: Assassin
fields.description: Attacks are more effective when the target has not detected the character.

fields.name: Bodybuilder
fields.description: +1 to actions based on raw Strength.

fields.name: Politician
fields.description: +2 to Charisma during formal negotiations and political discussions.

fields.name: Field Medic
fields.description: +1 when stabilizing injuries or using mundane medical supplies.

fields.name: Quick Draw
fields.description: Drawing or changing a readied weapon does not slow the character's first action.

fields.name: Shield Expert
fields.description: +1 when blocking with a shield or protecting an adjacent ally.

fields.name: Tracker
fields.description: +2 when following a trail left by a known creature.

fields.name: Arcane Student
fields.description: +1 when identifying a RULE, rune, or magical phenomenon.

fields.name: Craftsperson
fields.description: +1 when repairing, evaluating, or creating mundane equipment.

fields.name: Duelist
fields.description: +1 when fighting a single visible opponent without nearby interference.

fields.name: Beast Friend
fields.description: +2 when calming or understanding ordinary animals.

fields.name: Sailor
fields.description: +2 to navigation, rigging, and balance aboard a vessel.

fields.name: Streetwise
fields.description: +1 when finding illicit goods, rumors, or safe routes through a city.

fields.name: Unshakable
fields.description: +1 to resist fear, intimidation, and supernatural dread.

fields.name: Cold Immunity
fields.description: The character cannot be frozen by ordinary cold.

fields.name: Poison Tolerance
fields.description: +2 to resist poison and identify common toxins by taste or smell.

fields.name: Ambidextrous
fields.description: The character can use either hand with equal precision.

fields.name: Battle Rhythm
fields.description: After a successful coordinated attack, the next allied action in the same turn gains +1.

fields.name: Rune Listener
fields.description: The character can sense whether a touched rune is dormant or active.

fields.name: Perfect Memory
fields.description: +2 when recalling a scene, route, face, or exact spoken detail.

fields.name: Improviser
fields.description: +1 when using an ordinary object for an unintended but plausible purpose.

fields.name: Last Stand
fields.description: +1 to actions while at or below 20% of maximum HP.

fields.name: Danger Sense
fields.description: +1 to Reflexes when reacting to an unseen or unexpected threat.

fields.name: Heavy Hitter
fields.description: A successful heavy melee attack produces a stronger positional effect.

fields.name: Lucky Break
fields.description: Once per session, reroll a failed non-critical utility roll.

fields.name: Inspiring Presence
fields.description: Once per scene, an ally who hears the character gains +1 against fear.

fields.name: Locksmith
fields.description: +2 to actions made to open or inspect ordinary mechanical locks.

fields.name: Burglar
fields.description: +2 to Dexterity actions for quietly entering, crossing, or leaving a secured building.

fields.name: Marksman
fields.description: +1 to ranged weapon attacks against a visible target at least 10 meters away.

fields.name: Brawler
fields.description: +1 to actions involving unarmed fighting or grappling.

fields.name: Herbalist
fields.description: +2 when identifying or working with medicinal or poisonous plants.

fields.name: Alchemist
fields.description: +2 to Intelligence actions for identifying, preparing, or safely handling alchemical substances.

fields.name: Blacksmith
fields.description: +2 to actions involving forging, evaluating, or repairing metal weapons, armor, and tools.

fields.name: Acrobat
fields.description: +2 to Dexterity actions involving balance, tumbling, or acrobatic movement.

fields.name: Investigator
fields.description: +2 to Perception actions when examining a scene for physical evidence.

fields.name: Commander
fields.description: +1 to Charisma actions made to coordinate a willing group under immediate pressure.

fields.name: Actor and Impersonator
fields.description: +2 to Charisma actions when performing or imitating a person studied in advance.

fields.name: Historian
fields.description: +2 to Intelligence actions involving historical knowledge.

fields.name: Runesmith
fields.description: +2 to actions involving identifying, understanding, or creating runes.
